Preflight Demo Program
DEMO-STATION-02
poc-0041 2026-08-27
MEETING NOTES — Who Carries a Cabin Item With No
Person Assignment
Date: 2026-08-27
Program: DEMO-PROGRAM-BETA
Attendees: PERSON-0034 for TEAM-0004; partner team's shift
lead; documentation coordinator; duty chair.
Purpose: Agree responsibility when a queue discussion
encounters a blank person assignment field. The cabin folder
is located through ISSUE-0032 and TASK-0087.
Decisions The owning team remains responsible for an
unresolved issue even when no person assignment is recorded.
Its shift lead arranges the next administrative contact and
selects a suitable person through the assignment process. The
meeting recorder's name must not fill the blank by default.
The documentation coordinator may gather a paper without
becoming the task assignee. Put the collecting role and
promised delivery date on the attachment request, separate
from the ownership fields. This distinction lets the next
shift continue paper collection without assuming an assignment
decision occurred.
A dispute about which team owns the discussion goes to the
duty chair before handover. Preserve the competing scope
descriptions and write the chair's decision beside them. The
sending desk carries the next contact until a receiving
arrangement is confirmed.
Action items
— Owner: PERSON-0034. Due: 2026-08-28. Add separate ownership
and collecting-role spaces to the cabin desk sheet.
_ owner: Partner shift lead. Due: 2026-08-28. Confirm who
D. Worker 0034
